latest_release.name: v0.88.0
latest_release.body:
- **[Breaking]**: Resolver: Read `"exports"` from the package root, and apply `"browser"` redirections after it, by default. Set `resolver.unstable_resolveExportsFromPackageRoot` and `resolver.unstable_applyBrowserSpecAfterExports` to `false` to opt out (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2174 by @robhogan)
 - **[Breaking]**: Default `transformer.asyncRequireModulePath` and `resolver.emptyModulePath` to `metro:runtime/...`, which aren't file paths. Custom resolvers must delegate unhandled `metro:` specifiers to `context.resolveRequest` (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2180 by @robhogan)
 - **[Breaking]**: Resolve the module system via `metro:runtime/polyfills/require`. A custom `resolver.resolveRequest` must delegate `metro:` specifiers it doesn't handle to `context.resolveRequest` (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2184 by @robhogan)
 - **[Breaking]**: `transformer.globalPrefix` now also prefixes `__r`, `__c`, `__registerSegment` and `__accept`, and the default run statement. Code that calls these by name must apply the prefix (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2186 by @robhogan)
 - **[Breaking]**: Remove the deprecated `redirectModulePath` from `ResolutionContext`. A custom resolver should drop any call to it and delegate to `context.resolveRequest` or `resolve`, which already apply `"browser"` redirections and return `{type: 'empty'}` for `false` (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2181 by @robhogan)
 - **[Breaking]**: Remove the deprecated `doesFileExist` from `ResolutionContext`, and the `DoesFileExist` type from `metro-resolver` (use `fileSystemLookup`) (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2181 by @robhogan)
 - **[Breaking]**: `ResolutionContext.isESMImport` is required (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2182 by @robhogan)
 - **[Breaking]**: Async bundle and HMR module URLs keep the file extension (`foo.js.bundle`), fixing lazy loading of `.cjs` and `.mjs` files, and of files that share a name with a sibling (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/1990 by @dasjideepak)
 - **[Breaking]**: Babel transformers can no longer return a `functionMap`. Apply the `plugins` passed by Metro and return the resulting Babel `metadata` to keep function names in stack traces (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2157 by @robhogan)
 - **[Breaking]**: `/symbolicate` no longer reads `req.rawBody`, and fails if a middleware has already read the request body (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2158 by @robhogan)
 - **[Breaking]**: Remove the `bundle_transform_progressed_throttled` event from `TerminalReportableEvent`. `TerminalReporter` subclasses should handle `bundle_transform_progressed`, which their `_log` now receives for every progress update (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2170 by @vzaidman)
 - **[Breaking]**: Source and JSON files containing the reserved string `_$$_METRO_`, including in comments and string literals, now fail to transform (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2155 by @robhogan)
 - **[Breaking]**: Remove the deprecated, always-`true` `hot` option from `getTransformOptions` (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2159 by @robhogan)
 - **[Feature]**: Custom serializers receive the reserved string as `options.reservedString` (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2155 by @robhogan)
 - **[Fix]**: Don't print the terminal status in the middle of bursts of output written outside of it, and don't wait for a pending status update before exiting (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2170 by @vzaidman)
 - **[Fix]**: Fall back to file-based resolution, instead of throwing a `TypeError`, when a package's `"exports"` field is not a string, array or object (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2187 by @kwy404)
 - **[Fix]**: Fix relative symlinks on a different Windows drive than the project root (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2161 by @ramya-2196)
 - **[Performance]**: ~5-10% faster resolution (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2181 by @robhogan)

> NOTE: Experimental features are not covered by semv
